mapper.sql: SELECT file_id,storage_provider AS provider,storage_container_ref AS container,storage_object_ref AS object_ref, object_version,content_hash,size_bytes,mime_type,storage_encryption_key_ref AS encryption_key_ref,scan_policy_id AS policy_id,scan_status,object_status, access_level,current_version_no,source_system,reason_code FROM t_file_object WHERE file_id=#{id}

upload_id,tenant_id,uploader_id,source_system,reason_code,display_name,expected_size,expected_mime,storage_provider, storage_container_ref AS container_ref,storage_object_ref AS object_ref,scan_policy_id,expires_time AS expires_at,status, access_level,replaces_file_id,replacement_no,base_object_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_file_upload WHERE upload_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT f.file_id AS fileId,f.source_system AS sourceSystem,f.reason_code AS reasonCode, COALESCE(cu.display_name,ou.display_name) AS displayName, f.mime_type AS mimeType,f.size_bytes AS sizeBytes,f.content_hash AS contentHash,f.scan_status AS scanStatus, f.object_status AS objectStatus,ou.uploader_id AS uploaderId,f.create_time AS createTime,f.update_time AS updateTime, f.access_level AS accessLevel,f.current_version_no AS currentVersionNo, (SELECT MAX(p.version_no) FROM t_file_version p WHERE p.file_id=f.file_id AND p.version_no > f.current_version_no AND p.version_status='CANDIDATE') AS pendingVersionNo, f.storage_provider AS provider,f.storage_container_ref AS container,f.storage_object_ref AS objectRef, b.public_base_url AS publicBaseUrl FROM t_file_object f LEFT JOIN t_file_upload ou ON ou.upload_id=f.upload_id LEFT JOIN t_file_version cv ON cv.file_id=f.file_id AND cv.version_no=f.current_version_no LEFT JOIN t_file_upload cu ON cu.upload_id=cv.upload_id LEFT JOIN t_file_storage_instance i ON i.instance_code=f.storage_provider LEFT JOIN t_file_storage_bucket b ON b.instance_id=i.instance_id AND b.bucket_name=f.storage_container_ref
mapper.select: SELECT u.display_name FROM t_file_version v JOIN t_file_upload u ON u.upload_id=v.upload_id WHERE v.file_id=#{fileId} AND v.version_no=#{versionNo}

SELECT r.requirement_id AS id,r.scanner_code,r.scan_type AS type,r.minimum_scanner_version AS minimum_version, r.accepted_result_codes AS accepted_codes,s.result_code FROM t_file_scan_requirement r JOIN t_file_scan_policy p ON p.policy_id=r.policy_id LEFT JOIN t_file_scan_result s ON s.file_id=#{fileId} AND s.file_version_no=#{versionNo} AND s.scan_requirement_id=r.requirement_id AND s.scan_policy_id=r.policy_id AND s.attempt_no=1 WHERE r.policy_id=#{policyId} ORDER BY r.requirement_no
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_upload SET status='COMPLETED',version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','UPLOADING') AND expires_time > #{now}
UPDATE t_file_object SET scan_status=#{status},available_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='AVAILABLE' THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE file_id=#{id}
